definitions.gloss: seven colors; the colors of the rainbow
definitions.explanation: traditionally the seven colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet
used figuratively to mean diverse or varied

notes:
THE TRADITIONAL SEVEN COLORS:
⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧ (red), ⟦{橙|だいだい}→橙：21180_daidai⟧ (orange), ⟦{黄|き}→黄：19352_ki⟧ (yellow), ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ (green), ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue), ⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧ (indigo), ⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧ (violet)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese culture, rainbows are traditionally seen as having seven colors. The {七|しち}{色|いろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧ (seven-colored rainbow) is a common poetic image.

USAGE:
{七色|なないろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (seven-colored voice) means a versatile singing voice with many different tones and expressions.
